thread:
maria: Heads-up — SunSetCorp dedicated cutover planned for tonight 23:00 UTC. There's a KMS rotation scheduled ~22:50 UTC that might collide. Need final authorization and rollback thresholds. Short details below.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: tenant=sunsetcorp mode=dedicated window=2025-03-18T23:00:00Z canary=5% duration=15m followups=30m. ID=deploy-1742123456. See CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/dep/1742123456

sam: KMS rotation window — do we have a safe key fallback? If rotation hits during cutover we could lose new secrets. @security?

jonathan: I can delay our rotation by 30m if needed, but prefer to keep it. Alternative: pin the tenant to model-version=redwood-v2.3.1 and kms-key=key-old until post-cutover.

adele: Proposal: pin model -> v2.3.1, canary 5% x15m, then 25% x30m, then full. Rollback triggers: error-rate >= 3% for 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 10m OR user-facing 5xx spike. If any trigger, immediate traffic cutback to previous slice and rollback to v2.2.8.

ops-runner: Canary orchestration plan (short):
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 15m
ramp:
  steps: [25, 100]
  step_duration: 30m
rollback_policy: immediate-on-threshold
monitoring: prometheus -> alert: #eng-oncall
```

security: Confirming: which KMS key will be used for private tenant blobs during cutover? We need audit entries and a temporary exception for rotation if you want us to delay. @maria please confirm CMK ARN.

maria: Using CMK: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. If we pin to key-old (arn:...:key/old1234) during cutover, we'll flip post-success. Logging will be kept and exported to S3 for 30d.

sam: OK — with that pin and auditable logs I'm good. Can ops confirm rollback playbook is staged and runbook link?

adele: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rollouts/sunsetcorp-cutover.md — includes steps to revert DNS routing and reassign slices. I added a checklist and slack escalation steps.

jonathan: Oncall: I'll watch telemetry from 22:45 — will be available via pager and Zoom. If p95 or error spike, I'll trigger rollback and ping #eng-releases.

maria: Short release note to attach to tenant: "Upgrade model to redwood-v2.3.1 for latency & token-cost improvements. Canary rollout; rollback plan in place. No data-plane changes. Expected downtime: none but brief degradation possible during ramp."

sam: ACK — :thumbsup: from infra/sre.

adele: ACK from product/ops. :white_check_mark:

security: ACK assuming audit export to S3 and rotation delay exception if rotation starts before 23:10.

deploybot: Scheduled deploy job deploy-1742123456 created by @maria. Will kick at 2025-03-18T23:00:00Z if no manual cancel. Logs will stream to https://logs.redwood/internal/deploy-1742123456

maria: Final call — any objections? If none, we'll proceed as scheduled and hold on rotation until 23:30.

sam: No objections from me.

jonathan: No objections.

ops-runner: No objections, runbook staged.

adele: No objections.

security: No objections (watching audit).

maria: Great — proceeding. I'll post a short postmortem checklist link in the thread after the cutover.

deploybot: NOTE: reminder scheduled 15m before deploy.
